Senior Officers Appointed to National Testing Agency Amid Exam Row

The Central government has appointed five senior officers to the National Testing Agency (NTA). Among the appointees is Prasanna Venkatesh, an IAS officer from the Andhra Pradesh cadre, who has been appointed as Director. This reshuffling of leadership at the NTA occurs in the wake of controversies surrounding the NEET and UGC-NET examinations, including allegations of paper leaks. The appointments aim to strengthen the agency's administration.
